name: io.github.borsty2103/viventii-mcp
title: Viventii Events, Leisure, POIs, Tickets & Ticket Resale
description: German & European events, POIs, leisure, 0%-fee tickets & verified ticket resale on Viventii.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Searches events and local places on Viventii across cities, dates, categories, keywords, budgets, and accessibility. Always returns verified city hub URLs alongside matching listings.

query.description: Free text search (e.g. "techno open air", "indie concert", "jazz")

specificDate.description: Date in European DD.MM.YYYY or ISO YYYY-MM-DD format

categories.description: Optional categories (e.g. Music, Parties, Art, Food, Theater, Sports, Outdoors, Family, Shopping, Education, Fairs)

onlyFree.description: Filter for events with free admission

latitude.description: User GPS latitude for proximity search

longitude.description: User GPS longitude for proximity search

tools.name: get_tonight_in_city
tools.description: Fast radar for tonight in a city using Europe/Berlin local time (18:00 - 06:00 nightlife cycle, including ongoing late-night events after midnight).

tools.name: get_weekend_in_city
tools.description: Finds events and things to do this weekend (Friday to Sunday) in a specific city, with optional district or category filter and direct weekend hub links.

category.description: Optional category key (e.g. Music, Parties, Art, Food, Sports, Family)

onlyFree.description: Filter for free weekend events only

tools.name: discover_what_to_do
tools.description: Answers open-ended questions like "Was ist los in [Stadt]?" or "Was kann ich heute / am Wochenende machen?" by combining mood/intent matching, event results, and curated Viventii city guide links.

city.description: City name (optional if coordinates are provided)

timeframe.description: Timeframe such as today, tonight, tomorrow, or weekend

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Provides the full profile of a specific event or place: description, lineup timetable, dresscode, age restrictions, door time, public transit, parking, iCal export link, and direct booking URLs without login redirect.

tools.name: get_event_tickets
tools.description: Checks real-time ticket availability, tiers, prices, resale status on secondary fan market, box office availability, and direct ticket purchase links.

eventIdOrSlug.description: The event ID or slug to check tickets for

tools.name: get_city_radar
tools.description: Overview of active cities on Viventii, popular genres, top venues, event counts, and curated direct city guide URLs.

tools.name: get_family_and_kids_events
tools.description: Curated search specifically tailored for families, parents, and kids. Supports weather-proof indoor filtering.

isIndoorOnly.description: Filter for indoor events (e.g. rainy day)

tools.name: list_cities_and_categories
tools.description: Returns all active normalized cities with event counts and direct city guide URLs plus all supported Viventii categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of cities to return (default 50)

tools.name: get_active_stories
tools.description: Fetches live 24-hour video and photo stories from clubs, organizers, and venues with direct Story Viewer links.

city.description: City name to filter stories for

eventId.description: Filter stories for a specific event ID

tools.name: get_my_saved_events
tools.description: Retrieves bookmarked events and favorites when an auth token or UID is supplied, or returns direct personal bookmarks links.

userTokenOrId.description: Optional Firebase user ID token or UID

tools.name: search_places_and_pois
tools.description: Searches permanent places and Points of Interest (POIs) on Viventii: attractions, museums, parks, zoos, cinemas, theaters, clubs, bars, restaurants, and shops.

query.description: Optional place, sight, or venue name/keyword

categories.description: Optional categories (Art, Outdoors, Family, Sports, Cinema, Theater, Music, Food, Shopping)

poiTypes.description: Optional POI types (museum, park, landmark, castle, zoo, aquarium, cinema, theater, swimming_pool, climbing_gym)

tools.name: find_tickets
tools.description: Finds events with buyable online tickets (0% organizer fee Viventii ticketing or official ticket link) including prices and direct booking URLs.

limit.description: Max ticketed events to return (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: explore_leisure_activities
tools.description: Recommends leisure activities, excursions, museums, parks, sports, workshops, cinema, and family spots for indoor, outdoor, or weekend plans.

setting.description: Filter indoor (museums, cinema, theater, workshops) or outdoor (parks, landmarks, nature, sports)

tools.name: get_release_radar
tools.description: Returns the newest event drops published on Viventii, with optional city, category, price type, and focus mode filters.

priceType.description: Filter by free or paid events

tools.name: get_organizer_profile
tools.description: Loads a verified Viventii organizer public profile (by slug or user ID) along with their upcoming public events.

identifier.description: Organizer public slug or user ID
